summary: MiMedx Group, Inc. entered into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Sanara MedTech Inc. through a merger of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mustang Merger Sub, Inc., with Sanara. Each Sanara share will be converted into $33.00 cash plus 0.4735 MiMedx shares (valued at $2.00 per Sanara share based on MiMedx's five-day average closing price), totaling $35.00 per share. Both boards unanimously approved the transaction. Sanara will survive as a wholly-owned subsidiary of MiMedx, with MiMedx stock listed on Nasdaq. Watch for regulatory approvals, shareholder votes, and appraisal rights in Texas.
